title: The plan gauge is sampled
body:
Outcome: a status line command appends `{time, session, five_hour, seven_day}` to a file under `.krn/`; the window prints dollars per plan point.
Why: plan limits, not dollars, are what stops work; the signal exists only in interactive sessions and is per account (`04` (g)), so it calibrates a window and attributes nothing.
Proof: a test feeds the sampler a captured status payload and reads the row back. After merge: one day of samples; the ledger prints the ratio for two windows.
Scope: `.claude/settings.json` (`statusLine`), a sampler script, `src/outcome`.
Order: B1, B2, B3; then the two measurements B6 and B7; B4 when the operator adds the line; B5 last.
Operator order 2026-11-10: ordinary in-project delivery.
Program: .krn/runs/krn-architecture-program/05-program.md section 4, slice B4.

Sampler shipped: `.claude/settings.json` statusLine runs `scripts/claude/plan-sample.ts`, which appends {time, session, five_hour, seven_day} to `.krn/plan/samples.jsonl` of the main checkout when a window moves (test feeds the spike-g capture). Remaining: one day of samples, then the window (after t-scj2bqy) prints dollars per plan point for two windows.
